summary.text: Amar Mukunda is the Democratic candidate for Maryland State Senate District 39 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An engineer and U.S. Army Reserve veteran, he won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary over incumbent Nancy King and Destiny Drake West.

paragraphs.text: Mukunda graduated from Walt Whitman High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Amherst College in 2015 and a graduate degree from Stanford University in 2025, and has worked as an engineer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign said he was born and raised in Montgomery County, the son of immigrants, received a master's degree in Energy and Infrastructure Engineering from Stanford, served in the U.S. Army Reserve as a Combat Engineer, and helped run what it called Maryland's largest gun violence prevention program.

The survey said his campaign is focused on reclaiming democracy, lowering the cost of living, creating gun-free schools, and meeting challenges including artificial intelligence, climate and infrastructure, and that as a senator he would close state-law loopholes so that federal immigration authorities cannot obtain state data without a warrant.
